title: Dispatch: 19.3.2 governed feature resource projection (attempt 1)
description:
Implement eshyra-o9bd.19.3.2 exactly per its DESIGN field (read it fully: root cause, DECISION on governing relations, USES rules, the EXPECTED table, REMOVE list, F-12 and indep:003 handling, registry rows, EVIDENCE). Importer work: follow docs/importer-fix-protocol.md (no hand edits of records.json; regenerate; explain every generated diff).

Files: packages/core/scripts/importers/dnd5e-srd-5.1/mechanicsProjections.ts (deriveFeatureMechanics ~L5235 and the saveDcFormula grammar), packages/core/scripts/importers/dnd5e-srd-5.1/emit.ts (remove RESOURCE_PROJECTION_WITHHELD_PENDING_F05 and withheldResources ~L870-898; keep the call site simple), packages/core/src/rules/kindSchemas.ts (validate the resource entry fields: uses (positive integer | '<ability>-modifier' | '1-plus-<ability>-modifier'), usesMinimum (positive integer), usesByLevel (non-empty, strictly increasing levels, positive uses), reset ('short-rest'|'long-rest'|'short-or-long-rest'|'day'), resource ('spell-slots'), appliesTo (a feature: key); fail closed on anything else — find where feature/trait mechanics.resources are validated today), docs/audits/dnd5e-srd-5.1-final/finding-registry.json (rows owned by eshyra-o9bd.19.3.2 per the DESIGN: phantom-feature-resources, indomitable-scaling, arcane-recovery-reset, natural-recovery-reset, divine-sense-uses keep 'accepted' with statusReasoning naming this change and its evidence; ki-abilities and class-feature-completeness become 'narrowed' with the DESIGN's reasoning; keep invariant/aliases/provenance/scopeKind/owner).

Approach: write the governing-relation grammar as a small set of named regexes over sentences (split the reconstructed text into sentences), each returning {reset, usesHint?}. Derive uses per the USES rules from the same text. Emit resources only when a governing relation matched. Keep every other mechanics projection byte-identical.

Regenerate: npm run import:dnd5e-srd -- --out packages/core/data/rules-packs/rules__dnd5e-srd-5.1 (and the default .generated run per the importer README); npm run verify:dnd5e-srd-pack must exit 0; regenerate docs/inventories/o9bd-18-8-8-semi-structured-boundary.{json,md} with packages/core/scripts/inventory-semi-structured-boundary.ts if its test requires it. Then diff records.json: EVERY changed record must be in the DESIGN's EXPECTED/REMOVE table or be a saveDcFormula incidental from the F-12 grammar extension; list each. If any other record changes, stop and report.

Tests (proportionate, per the DESIGN's EVIDENCE): one new test file under packages/core/test/importers/dnd5e-srd-5.1/ with (1) a table-driven exact assertion of the EXPECTED map and REMOVE list over the real committed pack (these are the source-fidelity regressions for F-03/F-04/F-05/F-06/F-24), (2) a generalized invariant over every record/trait/background-feature carrying mechanics.resources: its text contains a governing relation sentence whose rest phrase matches the entry's reset — implement that predicate independently in the test (simple, readable regexes), do not import the importer's function, (3) a grammar unit table with negatives (occasion-only sentences: 'during a short rest', 'at the end of a long rest', 'can be done during a short rest', 'when you finish a short or long rest, the DC resets to 10' -> no resource). Update existing expectations that encoded the old keyword behavior ONLY where the DESIGN's table proves them wrong; state each such change in your report (preserves/strengthens/replaces).
DO NOT: touch freeze-manifest hashes or thaw notes; touch engine code under packages/core/src/character or state (no engine consumes feature resources); widen into option-local work (19.3.1).
HARD STOP: If the failure map reveals a new root cause, requires a new parser or extractor strategy, or creates generated churn outside the direct consequences of the current minimal fix, stop and report instead of broadening the implementation. Do not add complexity solely to suppress source-confirmed incidental improvements caused by the correct fix.
REPORT (bd notes): every changed record with before/after resources, incidental records, changed existing tests with rationale, commands and results.
